concept: AWS Config: detection + auto-remediation via SSM Automation
tests: The combination for detecting open SSH 0.0.0.0/0 in a security group and fixing it automatically.
expected: AWS Config managed rule (restricted-ssh) + a remediation action using an SSM Automation document that removes the rule. Triggers: "automatically remediate", "detection and automatic remediation", "0.0.0.0/0 SSH".
why_not: CloudTrail only records the change; manual audits are slow; Inspector network reachability assesses exposure without fixing it.
